description: A jig that presents two objects at 194 mm: a 50 mm ball and a 100 mm jar. Hand-scale on purpose. A hand with no arm cannot travel to anything, so the only world it can be asked to hold something in is one where the thing is already between its fingers -- which is also how a hand gets tested on a bench before it is bolted to a wrist. The placement is tight because it has to be: an armless hand's reachable shell is the few millimetres its fingertips sweep, 192 to 198 mm on this bearing, and either side of that is a refusal.
